labels.description:
Labels applied to the PR.

Gitea returns the same `Label` shape on PRs as on issues. The list
endpoint includes this field by default, but `#[serde(default)]`
keeps responses (or fixtures) that omit it deserializable.

Label.title: Label
Label.description:
A label applied to a Gitea issue or pull request.

Gitea uses a single `Label` shape for both issues and PRs.

exclusive.description: Whether the label is exclusive within its scope.

url.description: Optional API URL for the label resource.

PullRequestFile.title: PullRequestFile
PullRequestFile.description: A file changed in a pull request.

number.description: Alternative field name for index (some endpoints use `number`).

pull_request.description: Pull request info (present if this issue is a PR).

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent
TimelineEvent.description: A timeline event on an issue.

TagCommit.description: Commit info embedded in a tag.

tag_name.description: Tag name associated with the release.

BranchCommit.description: Head commit of a branch, as embedded in [`Branch`].

GitRef.title: GitRef
GitRef.description:
A Git reference from `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs/{ref}`.

Note: Gitea returns an **array** of refs for this endpoint, unlike GitHub.

GitRefObject.description: Object pointed to by a Git reference.
